svg.desc: Барограф для отображения периода удвоения мощности

rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub ValCalc() Dim thh as double thh = _This.height If pv == nothing Then body.y = 0 body.height = thh FColor = Color_ErLink Exit Sub End If
Dim val As double Dim f as float Dim delta as float Dim start as float Dim a as float
val = pv.Value val_AB = pv_ana.Value If val != 0 Then f = 1 / val End If
If (f < (-1) / 160.0) Then f = -1 / 160.0 ElseIf (f > 1 / 20.0 + 1 / 160.0) Then f = 1 / 20.0 + 1 / 160.0 End If If (pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) || (pv_ana.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) || (val == 0)Then FColor = Color_Inval ElseIf (val <= val_AB) && (val > 0) Then FColor = Color_ANA_HI_A Elseif (val <= (val_AB * 2)) && (val > 0) Then FColor = Color_ANA_HI_P Else FColor = M_Color End If
start = thh / 10.0 * 9.0 delta = thh / (1 / 20.0 + 2 / 160.0) If val == 0 Then body.y = 0 body.height = thh ElseIf val > 0 Then body.y = start - f * delta body.height = f * delta ElseIf Show_SubZero Then body.y = start body.height = Abs(f * delta ) Else body.height = 0 End If
End Sub

Sub ShowBoard(ByVal board as double, ByVal B_Border as RtSvgObj, ByVal B_Line as RtSvgObj) Dim f as float If board != 0 Then f = 1 / board Dim y as float Dim delta as float Dim start as float Dim thh as float
thh = _This.height start = thh / 10.0 * 9.0 delta = thh / (1 / 20.0 + 2 / 160.0) If (f > 0.05625) Then y = 0 ElseIf (f < (-1 / 160.0)) Then y = thh Else y = start - f * delta End If B_Border.y1 = y B_Border.y2 = y B_Line.y1 = y B_Line.y2 = y End If
End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
Dim thh as double Dim thw as double Dim i as ubyte
thh = _This.height
InGr.y = -2.5 If Show_SubZero Then InGr.height = thh + 5 Backgr_frame.height = thh Backgr_rect.height = thh BotLineBorder.y1 = thh BotLineBorder.y2 = thh BotLine.y1 = thh BotLine.y2 = thh SelArea.height = thh Else InGr.height = (thh / 10.0 * 9) + 5 Backgr_frame.height = thh / 10.0 * 9 Backgr_rect.height = thh / 10.0 * 9 BotLineBorder.y1 = thh / 10.0 * 9 BotLineBorder.y2 = thh / 10.0 * 9 BotLine.y1 = thh / 10.0 * 9 BotLine.y2 = thh / 10.0 * 9 SelArea.height = thh / 10.0 * 9 End If Digits_Dig20.y = thh / 10.0 - 2.5 Digits_Dig40.y = thh / 2.0 - 2.5 Digits_Dig80.y = thh / 10.0 * 7 - 2.5 Digits_Dig160.y = thh / 10.0 * 8 - 2.5 //Digits_DigBesk.y = thh / 10.0 * 9 DigMin160.y = thh - 2.5 HB_Group_HB_Border.y1 = thh / 10.0 HB_Group_HB_Border.y2 = thh / 10.0 HB_Group_HB_Line.y1 = thh / 10.0 HB_Group_HB_Line.y2 = thh / 10.0 LB_Group_LB_Border.y1 = thh / 2.0 LB_Group_LB_Border.y2 = thh / 2.0 LB_Group_LB_Line.y1 = thh / 2.0 LB_Group_LB_Line.y2 = thh / 2.0 Lines_Line160.y1 = thh / 10.0 * 8 Lines_Line160.y2 = thh / 10.0 * 8 Lines_Line80.y1 = thh / 10.0 * 7 Lines_Line80.y2 = thh / 10.0 * 7 Lines_LineBesk.y1 = thh / 10.0 * 9 Lines_LineBesk.y2 = thh / 10.0 * 9 Lines_Line20.y1 = thh / 10.0 Lines_Line20.y2 = thh / 10.0 Lines_Line40.y1 = thh / 2.0 Lines_Line40.y2 = thh / 2.0
thw = _This.width // ширина If thw < 30 Then thw = 30 End If
Backgr_frame.width = thw - 25 Backgr_rect.width = thw - 25 InGr.width = thw - 20 BotLineBorder.x2 = thw TopLineBorder.x2 = thw BotLine.x2 = thw TopLine.x2 = thw HB_Group_HB_Border.x2 = thw - 15 HB_Group_HB_Line.x2 = thw - 15 LB_Group_LB_Border.x2 = thw - 15 LB_Group_LB_Line.x2 = thw - 15 /* AB_Group_AB_Border.x2 = thw - 15 AB_Group_AB_Line.x2 = thw - 15 */ Lines_Line20.x2 = thw Lines_Line40.x2 = thw Lines_Line160.x2 = thw Lines_Line80.x2 = thw Lines_LineBesk.x2 = thw body.width = thw - 25 SelArea.width = thw Digits_Dig20.x = thw - 7.5 Digits_Dig40.x = thw - 7.5 Digits_Dig80.x = thw - 7.5 Digits_Dig160.x = thw - 15 //Digits_DigBesk.x = thw - 10 DigMin160.x = thw - 17.5

Set pv = RTAPLS.AnaPV(FKKS1) Set pv_ana = RTAPLS.AnaPV(FKKS2)
body.visibility = "visible" M_Color = Middle_Color_Wieghted(Color_ANA_GOOD, 0xcdcdcd, 0.5) If (pv == Nothing) || (pv_ana == Nothing) Then HasError = true FColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Exit Sub End If
val_AB = pv_ana.Value val_HB = pv_ana.Value * 2
if val_AB != 0 Then ShowBoard(val_AB, HB_Group_HB_Border, HB_Group_HB_Line) ShowBoard(val_HB, LB_Group_LB_Border, LB_Group_LB_Line) End If

rect.rt:event: If HasError Then NoLink(FKKS1) Else Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", FKKS1 + "|" + FKKS2) //Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", FKKS1 + "|" + CStr(-1)) End If
If HasError Then NoLink(FKKS1) Else LoadPopUpMenu(FKKS1 + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + FKKS1 + "|" + CStr(-1)) End If
